name: /antinuke enable
desc: Turn on Anti-Nuke protection for this server.

name: /antinuke threshold
desc: Set how many destructive actions trigger a lockdown.

name: /antinuke whitelist add
desc: Exempt a trusted admin from Anti-Nuke thresholds.

name: /antinuke whitelist remove
desc: Remove a member from the Anti-Nuke whitelist.

name: /antinuke punishment
desc: Choose what happens to a triggering account: strip roles, kick, or ban.

name: /lockdown
desc: Immediately freeze all channels — no one below staff can send messages.

name: /automod spam
desc: Toggle the spam/flood message filter.

name: /automod invites
desc: Block or allow Discord invite links being posted.

name: /automod filter add
desc: Add a word or phrase to the blocked-content list.

name: /automod filter remove
desc: Remove a word from the blocked-content list.

name: /automod links
desc: Restrict which domains members are allowed to post.

name: /automod mentions
desc: Cap how many users/roles can be pinged in one message.

name: /backup create
desc: Take a manual snapshot of roles, channels, and permissions right now.

name: /backup list
desc: Show all saved snapshots for this server.

name: /backup restore
desc: Roll the server back to a chosen snapshot.

name: /backup schedule
desc: Set how often automatic snapshots are taken.

name: /ban
desc: Ban a member, with an optional reason and message-delete window.

name: /kick
desc: Remove a member from the server.

name: /timeout
desc: Temporarily mute a member for a set duration.

name: /warn
desc: Log a formal warning against a member's record.

name: /case
desc: Look up a member's full moderation history.

name: /purge
desc: Bulk-delete recent messages in a channel.

name: /slowmode
desc: Set a per-user message cooldown on a channel.

name: /alerts channel
desc: Set which channel Starla posts security alerts in.

name: /alerts test
desc: Send a test alert to confirm the channel is wired up right.

name: /alerts critical-ping
desc: Toggle a role ping for critical severity events only.

name: /serverinfo
desc: Show verification level, boost tier, member count, and more.

name: /userinfo
desc: Look up join date, roles, and account age for a member.

name: /permcheck
desc: Audit a role's permissions against Starla's hardening recommendations.

name: /ping
desc: Check Starla's response time and uptime.

name: /help
desc: List every command, or get details on one.
